summary: EfficientNet-B5 paired-view v2 Phase 2 run using full images plus 456px crops, task_gated_residual fusion, crop_prior initialization, lr=5e-5, backbone_lr_scale=0.1, batch_size=6, grad_accum_steps=4, cosine scheduler, and unfrozen heads. Training completed all 30 epochs after resuming from epoch 20. Best overall accuracy was 76.22% at epoch 22, making this the strongest Phase 2 run so far versus b5_crop_v3 at 75.87% and b5_full_v3 at 75.57%. The main gains are architectural_style and building_form: paired-v2 reaches 73.55% architectural_style and 67.32% building_form at the best checkpoint, beating both crop-only and full-only baselines. Phase 1 retention is mixed: primary_cladding is strong at 77.70%, stories is stable around 73.62%, but roof_type lags the full and crop baselines at 62.10%, and setting exact match is below the full-image baseline. Use best_model_phase2.pth from epoch 22 as the comparison-best checkpoint; final epoch 30 drifted slightly down to 75.97% overall.

results.trend: Accuracy improved gradually from 75.27% at epoch 1 to 76.22% at epoch 22, then drifted slightly to 75.97% by epoch 30 while val_loss continued rising. Best-by-accuracy remains the right checkpoint for comparison and downstream use.

vs_b5_crop_v3_phase2.overall: +0.35pp (76.22% vs 75.87%). Paired-v2 is the new best overall Phase 2 checkpoint.
vs_b5_crop_v3_phase2.architectural_style: +1.57pp (73.55% vs 71.98%). Full-image context appears to help style recognition when fused carefully with crops.
vs_b5_crop_v3_phase2.building_form: +1.94pp (67.32% vs 65.38%). This is the clearest Phase 2 gain from paired full+crop input.
vs_b5_crop_v3_phase2.stories: -2.10pp (73.62% vs 75.72%). Crop-only remains better for storey geometry.
vs_b5_crop_v3_phase2.roof_type: -1.59pp (62.10% vs 63.69%). Roof type still wants stronger crop preservation or task-specific handling.
vs_b5_crop_v3_phase2.primary_cladding: +1.21pp (77.70% vs 76.49%). Paired-v2 preserves or improves cladding detail.

vs_b5_full_v3_phase2.overall: +0.65pp (76.22% vs 75.57%). Paired-v2 improves the best full-image baseline.
vs_b5_full_v3_phase2.roof_type: -2.77pp (62.10% vs 64.87%). Full-image v3 remains better on roof_type in this comparison.
vs_b5_full_v3_phase2.setting_exact: -2.13pp (74.78% vs 76.90%). Full-image context is still best for setting.

comparison.vs_b5_pair_v2_phase1_expectation: Phase 2 is where paired full+crop finally paid off. Phase 1 paired-v2 did not beat crop-only, but Phase 2 paired-v2 becomes the best overall checkpoint because style and form benefit from full-image massing/context without fully sacrificing crop detail.

learnings: Paired full+crop is validated for Phase 2. The expected context payoff did not appear in Phase 1, but it does appear for architectural_style and building_form.
task_gated_residual fusion is good enough to beat both single-view baselines overall. The gain is modest (+0.35pp over crop-only) but meaningful because it comes with stronger Phase 2 heads.

The main remaining weakness is task-specific retention. Roof_type underperforms both crop-only and full-only baselines, and stories underperforms crop-only. These tasks still need stronger crop preservation or a crop-only bypass during Phase 2.
Setting did not retain the full-image advantage despite paired input. The model may need task-routed full-image features for setting rather than the current crop-prior fusion path.

Best loss and best accuracy diverge sharply: val_loss is lowest at epoch 5, but best accuracy is epoch 22. This matches prior B5 behavior where confidence calibration worsens while classification accuracy continues improving.

The final epoch is not the best checkpoint. Future Phase 2 runs should use early stopping or checkpoint selection by overall accuracy, with patience around 8-12 epochs after the best accuracy plateau begins.
next_steps: Use outputs/data2/b5_pair_v2/phase2/best_model_phase2.pth as the new best Phase 2 comparison checkpoint.

Run a paired-v3 Phase 2 preservation experiment from the paired-v2 Phase 1 checkpoint with --paired-gate-overrides roof_type=0.03,stories=0.01, --paired-residual-scales roof_type=0.5,stories=0.25, and --paired-crop-bypass-tasks stories. Consider adding roof_type to the bypass if roof retention is the priority.

Consider task-routed fusion for setting: full-image or full-heavy features for setting, crop-heavy features for stories/roof_type/primary_cladding, and paired features for architectural_style/building_form.
Add early stopping or best-accuracy patience to reduce wasted epochs after the accuracy plateau. Epoch 22 was best; epochs 23-30 mostly added val_loss without improving the selected checkpoint.
Keep b5_crop_v3 and b5_full_v3 as diagnostic baselines, but use paired-v2 Phase 2 as the current production/comparison leader.
operational_notes: The run was resumed after an epoch-25 checkpoint write failure caused by low disk space. The final history contains all 30 epochs and best_model_phase2.pth is valid at epoch 22.
Non-best checkpoint_epoch*.pth files were removed during disk cleanup after training. The retained best_model_phase2.pth and best_model_by_loss_phase2.pth checkpoints are valid and loadable.

The saved run_config.json reflects the resumed checkpoint path rather than the original Phase 1 warm-start path. Interpret the training lineage as paired-v2 Phase 2 resumed from an in-phase checkpoint after starting from outputs/data2/b5_pair_v2/phase1/best_model_phase1.pth.
